QuestInfo.name: [Odium] The Wellspring
QuestInfo.0: What awaited you in the #bGenerator Room#k was...
QuestInfo.1:
You listen to Hundun and obtain the original Godsphere.
But when you come to your senses, you're in a strange place.
Maybe if you follow the flame, you'll be able to leave.	

(Enter the Wellspring again if you want to go back to the fated battleground.)
QuestInfo.2:
The mysterious flame was the soul of a nameless person.
You met the past Adversaries in the ethereal place, and became sure the flame was also an Adversary.
You were tested again and again by the other Adversaries, but you did not waver. Having been acknowledged by the others, you were allowed to return to Odium.

You weren't able to clearly understand the soul, but maybe it was trying to tell you something...
